title: Figure 2: Light-bending in a spacetime-altered region (starlight deflected by the sun)
description: Simple illustration of a star at upper left emitting a light ray that curves around a large yellow sun, with short blue cross-lines marking wavefronts along the bent path ending in an arrow. The caption reads "Figure 2. Light-Bending in a Spacetime-Altered Region." It accompanies a section on "Refractive Index Effects" discussing lensing, apparent size changes and possible "cloaking" of an exotic craft.
